resources.string: Offline tools • no account, ads, or watermark. Originals stay unchanged. Up to 50 files and 1,000 output pages per job.
Example: 1-3, 7, 5-4. Arabic numerals are accepted. Repeated pages are kept.
Choose at least two PDFs. Use Up and Down to set their order. Text stays searchable. Signed or interactive documents may lose document-level features; keep the originals.
Choose one PDF, then enter pages to keep in the order you want. This creates a new document; it does not redact hidden information.
Choose images and arrange their order. Images are fitted to A4, rotated using camera metadata, and resized to at most 2,048 pixels on the longest side. This does not perform OCR.
PDF created and reopened successfully. Save a copy to keep it.
Could not complete the operation. Check file access, available storage, and page numbers (maximum 1,000). Password-protected PDFs are not supported in these tools yet.
